Jeremy Dean Hearn

Independent candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Challenger

Not stated in available sources

Jeremy Dean Hearn is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate from Collierville, Tennessee. He qualified by petition and filed on February 20, 2026. Independents in Tennessee do not run in a primary, so his name goes straight onto the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where Hearn stands

Campaign finance
Asks each supporter for a $1 pledge. He says larger amounts add to corruption that comes into government through campaign contributions. He says he will report donations to the FEC and return unused money on request.
National debt / fiscal policy
Proposes 'activation of US_Fort Knox': $3.3 trillion for 365-day legislation and settling the $33 trillion national debt at the start, which he says would give Americans relief.
Wages / economy
Proposes drafting an 'Equal Earnings Act'. He describes a government-linked work and operating-budget system meant to raise workers' pay and allow investment in innovation while keeping regulatory accountability.
Foreign policy
Supports local and global peace negotiations and says he would offer '21st century economic alternatives to war'.
Constitution / democracy
Lists his campaign priorities as defending the U.S. Constitution, clarifying history and restoring equality. He says he will help 'undo the recent acts of insurrection'. He signed the Purple Pledge.
